sceneries._n: OGRS Allotment — 4 plots in a 2x2 grid with 1-tile walking lanes between them. East of Lumbridge castle.
Compost heap — south-east corner outside the fence (model is 2x2, occupies 153..154 / 653..654).
Garden fence — NORTH wall, 5 tiles. Direction 0 = fence runs east-west. Caps the top of the field.
Garden fence — WEST wall, 3 tiles. Direction 1 = fence rotated to run north-south.
Garden fence — EAST wall, 3 tiles. Direction 1.
Garden fence — SOUTH stubs framing the entry. 2 tiles on each corner; the middle 3 tiles (149..151, 652) are the open gate the player walks through.
